faqs.q: What occasion is Violet Gold Vine best for?
faqs.a: Receptions, engagements and festive evenings. The sleeve work is the highlight, so it suits sarees draped to show the arms.

faqs.q: Which sarees go well with Violet Gold Vine?
faqs.a: Violet, purple, antique gold and cream silk blend with the vine embroidery. Deep green or wine gives more contrast. Choose a saree whose zari echoes the gold.

faqs.q: Can the sleeve embellishment be lighter?
faqs.a: Yes. We can space out the linear rows or drop the stones and keep only the gold vines. That usually brings the price down too. We confirm the change before you pay.

faqs.q: Can you change the colours or motifs on Violet Gold Vine?
faqs.a: Yes. Most brides change something: the thread colour to match their saree, a denser or lighter fill, or a different neckline and sleeve finish. Send your saree photo on WhatsApp and we will tell you what works and whether it changes the price.

faqs.q: How do I order Violet Gold Vine?
faqs.a: Tap WhatsApp or Make It Yours and send your saree photo and event date. We confirm the design, price, courier charge and delivery date. You pay a 50% advance, courier your blouse to our Trichy studio, and we send it back by tracked courier once the work is done.
